preconditions.description: The number of nodes n in the tree must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, as it is a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: All node indices in the edges must be valid and within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the number of nodes m in the T-decomposition.
The output must contain m lines for node descriptions and m - 1 lines for edges.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == int(line.split()[0]) + 1 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:m+1])
postconditions.description: Each node description line must have the correct number of node indices.
